items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I used to watch Betsy Grant, I watched Wilmer Allison, I watched Tilden -- I watched them all.

ctx.x: I know that game. Like, I almost wrote the book. I used to watch Betsy Grant, I watched Wilmer Allison, I watched Tilden -- I watched them all.
